answer: A Dedicated device bound by in-person pickup code with annual re-verification ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone karst cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. A voyage and a vault may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
